title: Notification for Cancellation of Horticulture Development Officer (HDO) Examinations

Dated: Itanagar, the 26th September, 2022
Due to administrative reasons, the Recruitment Test(Rn and Written
Examination of Horticulture Development officer(HDO) conducted on 24th May, 2022
and 24th & 25th August, 2022 respectively stands cancelled.
Fresh notifications/dates for all the above examination will be communicated in
due course.
